gloss: children (as a blessing); the gift of children

definitions.gloss: children as a treasure or blessing; the gift of children
definitions.explanation: A warm expression viewing children as precious treasures or blessings. Often used when talking about being blessed with children. Composed of 子 (child) + 宝 (treasure).

examples.japanese: {子宝|こだから}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれた→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧。
{子宝|こだから}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧よう⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We visited a shrine to pray for the blessing of children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧「⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宝|たから}→宝：03401_takara⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{子宝|こだから}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なに}に⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{代|か}え→代える：11717_kaeru⟧がたい。
examples.english: As the saying goes, 'children are treasures' — the gift of children is irreplaceable.

notes:
USAGE:
{子宝|こだから} expresses the traditional Japanese view that children are precious blessings. The most common usage is the set phrase {子宝|こだから}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧ (to be blessed with children).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子宝|こだから}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧ (to be blessed with children)
- {子宝|こだから}⟦{祈願|きがん}→祈願：13745_kigan⟧ (praying for children)
- {子宝|こだから}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot spring said to promote fertility)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many shrines and temples in Japan are known for {子宝|こだから}⟦{祈願|きがん}→祈願：13745_kigan⟧ (fertility prayers). Certain hot springs (⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧) are also traditionally associated with promoting fertility.
